candidate_relations.reason: Nephrolithiasis is a different cause of obstruction; retrograde study showed extrinsic compression and medial ureteral deviation, not stones.
Creatinine rose to 8.18 then returned to baseline after stents, so chronic kidney disease is not the retroperitoneal fibrosis diagnosis.
Ureteral obstruction is the mechanism of AKI from retroperitoneal fibrosis, not the idiopathic fibrosis itself.
Ureteral stenosis describes extrinsic compression from the mass rather than idiopathic retroperitoneal fibrosis.
COPD is a listed comorbidity, not the retroperitoneal mass diagnosis.
Ureteral tumor is an incompatible intrinsic neoplastic cause of obstruction versus an encasing retroperitoneal mass.
Desmoid tumor is a different fibroblastic mass and is not idiopathic retroperitoneal fibrosis.
Hypertension is a comorbidity, not the retroperitoneal fibrosis diagnosis.

case_quality_flags: No complete_equivalent candidate; idiopathic retroperitoneal fibrosis is not named despite classic medial ureteral deviation and encasing retroperitoneal mass.
